Bounsweet Juice.desc: Sickly-sweet fermented juice made by Bounsour. Heals 1/3 when switching, grants Big Root (2x with Appetite) and complete immunity to Bug & Poison type moves.

Petrified Wood.desc: Sudowoodo gains "Petrify", Grass STAB+Resist, Rock Head, and gains 50% Speed when below half. In rain, USING a move switches. Switches when hit by Water.

Lucky Donut.desc: A special donut cherished by Quagsire. When held, it grants Quagsire's team Good Fortune, and can be eaten like Kee/Maranga Berry, doubling w/Appetite.

Comet Shard.desc: If held by Minior or the Swellow line, they gain Life Orb, Refraction, Good Fortune and instant use of 2 turn moves. Latios loses Fortune. Latias loses Life Orb.

Sun Stone.desc: A strange, glowing stone that is hot to the touch. If held by Solrock, it gains Solar Power & Refraction.

Moon Stone.desc: A strange, glowing stone that is cold to the touch. If held by Lunatone, it gains Magic Bounce & Refraction.

Dubious Disc.desc: If held by Porygon-Z, it gains: Psychic, Steel & Bug STAB, becomes Infectious, 50% Speed boost if under half HP, & switches out (one time) if stats are lowered.

Up-Grade.desc: A software update that evolves Porygon. If held by Porygon2, it gains Energy Shield, Analytic, Psychic & Steel STAB, and Full Metal Body.

Smelly Sachet.desc: A sachet filled with overwhelming fragrances. If held by the Aromatisse line, they gain Pungent Aroma, priority on status moves & Shield Dust.

Heart Scale.desc: A radiant, heart-shaped scale that is very rare. If held by Luvdisc, Alomomola, Nidorina or Nidoqueen, they gain Refraction & Soul Heart.

Savage Scale.desc: A scale that fell off during a violent fight. When held by Basculin, Nidorino or Nidoking, they gain effects of Moxie, Rough Skin and Stakeout.

Dragon Scale.desc: If held by the Dratini line or Kingdra, they gain a 50% Dragon damage boost, take less from super-effective moves & ignore secondary effects.

Protector.desc: A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff and heavy. If held by Rhyperior, it gains Solid Rock, and ignores secondary effects & phasing moves.

Prism Scale.desc: A beautiful, iridescent scale. If held by Milotic, it gains Prism Armor, Refraction and ignores secondary effects of moves.

Reaper Cloth.desc: If held by the Duskull line, gains a 50% Ghost boost, resist + Covert Cloak. Dusknoir also absorbs souls for 50% of damage dealt, and is immune to crits.

King's Rock.desc: A crown-like rock. If held by Slowking, it gains Analytic, Neuroforce and Rock STAB. It also functions like a Rocky Helmet, dealing 1/6 HP.

Silver Powder.desc: A fine, irritating powder that boosts Bug moves by 20%. If held by Dustox, also gains effects of Poisonous, Shield Dust & crit immunity.

Talisman.desc: A mystical amulet that wards off evil spirits. If held by Stantler, Ghost/Fairy is boosted and resisted by 50%. Grants Cursed Body, Magic Guard & Good Fortune.

Arcane Orb.desc: An enchanted orb brimming with ancient, forbidden magic. If held by the Spellsprout family, they gain Shadow Shield, Magic Guard and Ghost/Dark STAB.

Chipped Tooth.desc: When held, Seviper & the Granbull line gain Strong Jaw. Granbull ALSO gains Mold Breaker & Dark/Steel STAB. Kingler line gains Battle Armor, Iron Barbs & drains 50%.

Shiny Scale.desc: This iridescent scale boosts the Ariados & Salamence line's Dragon-type moves by 50%, and grants Magic Bounce. Ariados line also takes 1/4 from Dragon.

Buried Seal.desc: An ancient band used to contain the energy of the Pyroar & Golurk lines. When held, they gain Sand Force, a 50% Ghost boost, & Magic Guard.

Detonator.desc: When held by the Togepi line, they gain 2x Atk, Rapid Fire, Incinerate, No Guard & Aftermath- but lose 25% of their max HP when attacking.

Metal Coat.desc: A shiny piece of metal that boosts Steel moves by 20%. If held by Registeel, Scizor or Steelix, they gain all 3 new effects of Full Metal Body.

Light Ball.desc: A ball teeming with electricity. When held by Pikachu, it grants a 50% boost to their offensive stats & a passive damage immunity. Arcanine line gains Showstopper.

Soft Sand.desc: A loose, silky sand that boosts Ground moves by 20%. If held by the Palossand line, they also gain Sand Spit + Regenerator & heal from the sand chip.

Hard Stone.desc: A durable stone that boosts Rock moves by 20%. If held by Regirock or Onix, they also become immune to stat drops, secondary effects & phasing.

Miracle Seed.desc: A seed imbued with life force, boosting Grass moves by 20%. If held by the Sunkern line, they gain Grassy Guard, and gain 1.5x Sp. Def + Heal 1/6 in the sun.

Black Glasses.desc: A pair of shady glasses that boost Dark moves by 20%. If held by the Krookodile line, also gains Moxie, Covert Cloak, Tinted Lens & Stakeout.

Chi Bracelet.desc: Harnesses the holders chi, boosting Fighting moves by 20%. If held by the Mienshao line, they gain: Dragonize, Technician, Psychic STAB+Neutrality.

Magnet.desc: A magnet that boosts Electric by 20%. If held by the Magnemite or Nosepass lines, also grants 50% Steel boost & summons Electric terrain when hit.

Mystic Water.desc: This teardrop gem boosts Water moves by 20%. If held by Phione or Manaphy, rain lasts 5 extra turns, gain Rain Dish & ignore secondary effects.

Sharp Beak.desc: Grants a 20% boost to Flying moves. If held by Spearow or Fearow, this also grants them Teravolt & +1 crit rate in addition to the boost.

Poison Barb.desc: This small, venomous barb boosts Poison moves by 20%. If held by Samurott or Seadra, also gains Poisonous, Rocky Helmet & Loaded Dice.

Never-Melt Ice.desc: A hardy block of ice that boosts Ice moves by 20%. If held by Regice or the Avalugg line, they become immune to stat drops, secondary effects & phasing.

Spell Tag.desc: A sinister, eerie tag that boosts Ghost moves by 20%. If held by Froslass, they also gain effects of Covert Cloak, Cursed Body and Ice Body.

Kaleidoscope.desc: Boosts Psychic moves by 20%. Bruxish & Lurantis BOTH set Light Screen when hit. Bruxish: Refraction. Lurantis: Scope Lens, Tangled Feet, & Tinted Lens.

Charcoal.desc: A combustible fuel that boosts Fire moves by 20%. If held by Ursaring, it burns itself, gains Flare Boost, (boosts Atk+Sp. Atk now) and gains Turboblaze.

Dragon Fang.desc: Boosts Dragon by 20%. If held by Haxorus line, Dragon moves deal 4x vs Steel, gains +1 crit rate, Mold Breaker, and Guillotine is boosted by 50%.

Silk Scarf.desc: This luxurious scarf boosts normal moves by 20%. If held by Furfrou, they also gain Adaptability and ignore secondary move effects.

Shell Bell.desc: This shell's soothing sound restores 25% damage dealt. Lapras also gains Shell Armor, Rock/Ground STAB & immunity to status/stat drops in sand.

Rusty Anchor.desc: A decrepit, old anchor cherished by Dhelmise. When held, Dhelmise gains the Steel typing- including both STAB and new resistances.

Pendulum.desc: Makes any attacker drowsy once per battle. Boosts accuracy by 50%. If the target is asleep, Hypno will drain 50% of damage dealt- like Dream Eater.

Star Gauntlet.desc: A glove formed from stardust. Pignite, Emboar & the Ledian line gain Iron Fist, and 2 turn moves need no charge. Ledian line also sets Light Screen when hit.

Strange Souvenir.desc: A tribal statue radiating with energy. If held by the Xatu or Gumshoos lines, they gain Solar Power and ignore secondary effects.

Burnt Leek.desc: Grants Farfetch'd 100% crit rate, +1 offensive stats when hit by a crit, and functions like Focus Sash. Farfetch'd clings to the charred remains with its life.

Mother's Egg.desc: Chansey's beloved egg. It will guard it with all of its might. When held, Chansey gains all 3 of the new Parental Bond effects.

Eternal Helmet.desc: An ancient helmet once lost to time. Grants Ghost & Psychic STAB/resistance, Justified (also boosts Sp. Atk), Good Fortune & Covert Cloak to Noctowl.

Ultra Space Dust.desc: A rare residue collected from Ultra Wormholes. Ditto gains 2x Speed and 1.5x Sp. Atk when not transformed- or 25% to all stats when transformed.

Toxic Vanity.desc: A mirror that feeds Unfezant's ego further. It grants the benefits of Pixilate & Moxie- but this comes at a cost- inflicting Defeatist & Toxic.

Metronome.desc: If held by Chatot or the Kricketune line, boosts the power of moves used consecutively by 35% maxing out at 2x damage. (1x, 1.35x, 1.70x, 2x)

Pig Iron.desc: Molten-hot steelworking scraps cherished by the Grumpig line. Grants Incinerate, Loaded Dice, +1 crit rate, Filter & blocks secondary move effects.

Icy Rock.desc: Extends the duration of snow by 3 turns. If held by the Feraligatr line, they also heal 1/6 in snow, and ignore secondary move effects and critical hits.

Smooth Rock.desc: Extends the duration of sand by 3 turns. If held by the Crustle line: Rock Head, status/stat drop immunity in sand & sets Stealth Rock when hit by physical moves.

Heat Rock.desc: Extends the duration of sun by 3 turns. If held by the Gigalith line, also gains a 1/4 Fire resist, burn & secondary effect immunity, and heals 1/6 in sun.

Damp Rock.desc: Extends the duration of rain by 3 turns. If held by Relicanth, it gains Rock Head, buffed Rain Dish, and immunity to secondary effects of moves.

Rotten Egg.desc: A once cherished egg has utterly spoiled. When held, Blissey gains the effects of Merciless, Poisonous and Liquid Ooze. It smells vile.

Prickly Pear.desc: A thorny fruit to be held by the Cacturne line & Maractus. Grants immunity to status/stat drops in sand, & passive Rocky Helmet+Crit immunity.

Magmarizer.desc: A cryptic machine bursting with heat. This helps Magmar evolve. If held by Magmortar, it gains Turboblaze and Flash Fire.

Electirizer.desc: A cryptic machine bursting with electricity. This helps Electabuzz evolve. If held by Electivire, it gains Teravolt & Motor Drive.

Trash Bag.desc: Rancid garbage that the Trubbish & A-Grimer lines love to eat. Grants Black Sludge, Covert Cloak, Poisonous, Liquid Ooze & Aftermath.

Graham Cracker.desc: A crunchy treat the S'Muk line munches for 6% HP each turn (2x w/Appetite). Blocks secondary effects & deals 6% chip damage if the cracker is touched.

Scaly Hood.desc: When worn by the Scrafty line, they become poisoned, ignore crits, secondary effects & all passive damage, & take 1/4 from Fairy & Poison.

Cracked Compass.desc: Machoke's compass once used to navigate the jungle. When held, it grants a 50% Grass boost, Wide Lens, Covert Cloak, & a 50% resist to Bug, Poison & Grass.

Desert Cloak.desc: A light, heat resistant cloak fashioned by Throh to survive harsh deserts. When worn, it grants a 50% Fire resist, Covert Cloak, and buffed Sand Force.

Arctic Coat.desc: A thick fur coat Sawk crafted to survive in the harsh cold of the tunda. When worn, it grants Covert Cloak, Ice Body and Refrigerate.

Rich Mulch.desc: A fertilizer for growing Berries even in cold climates. If held by the Meganium line, they gain Seed Sower & Big Root effects.

Cryo-Jelly.desc: Ooze harvested by Combee, releasing a freezing vapor. When held, grants Combee & Vespiquen 50% Defense in Snow, Ice STAB, Ice Body & immunity to crits.

Coconut.desc: A tough, unripe coconut. Passimian or Exeggutor gain a 50% Grass damage boost & are protected from critical hits & recoil. Chimpeace > Chimpower.

Spoiled Milk.desc: Infects the Pokémon holding it. If held by Miltank, they also become poisoned and gain Poison Heal, Regenerator, as well as Poison STAB + resistance.

Root Fossil.desc: When held by Lileep line, gains Seaweed (Leech Seed effects + 50% Grass Boost), Big Root, Rain Dish (1.5x Sp. Def/10% Heal) and Suction Cups.

Leaf Fan.desc: Oranguru or Shiftry gain a 50% Grass/Flying boost & Grassy Guard. Shiftry gains +1 crit rate. Oranguru gains Analytic. Swaps Chimpower to Chimpeace.

Wooden Log.desc: When held by Komala or Timburr, grants a 50% Grass boost, Grassy Guard, Covert Cloak & immunity to phasing. Komala also gains Headstrong & Filter.

Sandy Stinger.desc: If wielded by Skorupi or Drapion, this grants +1 crit rate, Poison STAB & resistance, Sand Force and Stakeout- in exchange for badly poisoning itself.

Concrete Pillar.desc: A heavy block of concrete to be held by Conkeldurr. Grants a 50% Rock boost, the effects of the ability Beatdown, Covert Cloak & immunity to phasing.

Liepard Pelt.desc: When worn by Machamp or Liepard, it acts as Covert Cloak. Liepard gains Fur Coat, while Machamp gains +1 offensive stats when hit by a Dark type move.

Skull Fossil.desc: A tough, fossilized skull. If held by the Cranidos line, they gain Battle Armor, Rock Head and Skull Bash does not need a charge-up turn.

Poison Ivy.desc: Grants the Serperior line the effects of Poisonous & Poison Heal, and poisons the holder. Also grants Poison STAB and immunity to Poison type moves.

Solar Panel.desc: Allows Butterfree to infinitely fire 2 turn moves such as Solar Beam without charging up. In the sun, they gain 50% Sp. Atk- but lose 1/8 HP per turn.

Frozen Crown.desc: When worn by Tyrantrum or Slaking, this crown grants immunity to critical hits and allows them to bypass various abilities when attacking.

Armor Fossil.desc: If held by the Shieldon line, they ignore opponent's attack boosts, are unphased by secondary effects & phasing moves, & gain Rock Head+Rocky Helmet.

Beast Ball.desc: A special Poké Ball designed to catch Ultra Beasts. If held by Electrode, it gains Static, Electric STAB and can be consumed to charge a 2 turn move.

Dream Ball.desc: A peculiar ball that radiates a soothing aura. If held by Voltorb, it makes any attacker drowsy once per battle & grants Good Fortune.

Bubble-Tron.desc: A bubble-making gadget. If held by the Wailord line, Pyukumuku, Octillery, Qwilfish or Corsola- they gain (buffed) Full Metal Body & Rain Dish.

Rainbow Charm.desc: A radiant pendant that allows the Furret line to draw more power from rainbows. Unlocks Prism Armor, Showstopper, Solar Power & Rain Dish.

Frozen Claw.desc: When held by Alolan Sandslash, Beartic or the Sneasel line, they gain Refrigerate and +1 crit rate. Sandslash also gains (buffed) Iron Barbs.

Toxic Claw.desc: Grants +1 crit rate & 50% Bug boost if held by the Gligar line, Sandslash or Scolipede. Gligar line are Poisonous. Others get Toxic Debris+Rocky Helmet.

Frosty Spoon.desc: If held by Kadabra or Alakazam, Ice moves will heal 50% (2x w/Appetite) and they gain "Snow Dish", AKA 1.5x Sp. Def + 1/6 heal in snow.

Spare Key.desc: Klefki will use up this extra key when attacking, moving quicker and stealing the foe's item after. Multi-hit moves will always hit 5 times.

Odd Keystone.desc: A cursed stone. If held by Spiritomb, it gains Shadow Shield, Cursed Body & Magic Guard. Eerie voices can be heard from it occasionally.

Absorb Bulb.desc: Boosts Atk/Sp.A if hit by Water- but is used up. If held by the Lilligant line, also gains Big Root, Storm Drain & buffed Rain Dish. (Sp. Def+Heal)

Cell Battery.desc: Boosts Atk/Sp.A if hit by Electricity- but is used up. Typhlosion line also gains the powerful effects of Trifecta and doesn't need to charge 2 turn moves.

Buried Idol.desc: An ancient statue of worship. If held by Sigilyph, Zen Darmanitan or the Claydol line, they gain Sandy Shield, Rock STAB and Magic Guard.

Old Amber.desc: A piece of amber crackling with static electricity. If held by Aerodactyl, it gains the effects of Galvanize, Rock Head and Battle Armor.

Fruit Crown.desc: When worn by Tsareena, she becomes Merciless, gains STAB on Dark/Fairy, ignores secondary move effects and gains Stakeout.

Crown of Madness.desc: A cursed crown that bestows Golduck great power at the cost of its sanity. Grants Magic Bounce, Psychic STAB, Neuroforce & blocks critical hits.

Sharp Bone.desc: When held by the Kabutops or Seaking lines, this deals 1/6 chip damage when an attacker makes contact, gives +1 crit rate, Big Root (50% HP drain) & blocks critical hits.

Old Insulation.desc: A hazardous roll of insulation that Cinccino loves. Grants Poison Heal+Toxic Orb, Poisonous, Poison STAB, and halves Fire/Ice/Electric/Water/Poison.

Sail Fossil.desc: A fossilized imprint of a strange sail. If held by Primora, it gains STAB on Grass, Water & Ice, and 2x Defense in Rain, Snow & Grassy Terrain.

Plume Fossil.desc: A fossilized imprint of a feather. If held by the Archen line, they gain the benefits of Gale Wings & Rock Head- but also the drawback of Defeatist.

Treasure Chest.desc: A lucky chest full of treasure that shines so brightly it hurts. If held by Omastar, Persian or Cofagrigus lines, gains Rock STAB, +1 crit rate, and Refraction.

Claw Fossil.desc: If held by the Anorith line, Bug moves deal 4x damage vs Steel, gains +1 crit rate & Battle Armor, as well as Water STAB+Neutrality.

Cover Fossil.desc: A tough, fossilized shell. If held by the Tirtouga line, they gain Bulletproof and ignore secondary effects of moves (Cover Cloak) & phasing moves.

Putrid Skull.desc: A rotting skull preserved in tar. When held by Druddigon, it grants Toxic Debris, Battle Armor and Rough Skin. It smells absolutely wretched.

Jaw Fossil.desc: A fossilized jaw bone. If held by Tyrunt, it gains Mold Breaker and Battle Armor.

Pyro Pendant.desc: A magical, burning charm held by the Arbok line. Grants Flare Heal+Flame Orb, Fire STAB and a 50% damage reduction from Fire type moves.

Steel Beam.desc: A hefty metal beam to be wielded by Gurdurr. Grants a 50% Steel Boost, Covert Cloak, and immunity to phasing + recoil damage.

Fairy Flower.desc: A delicate flower that boosts Fairy by 20%. If held by Comfey, the Flabebe or Cutiefly line, they gain Big Root, Seed Sower, & Sap Sipper.

Luminous Moss.desc: A moist and vibrant moss. If held by the Hippowdon line, they gain STAB on Grass & Water moves, Grassy Guard (2x Def) and Rain Dish. (1.5x Sp. Def+Heal)

Snowball.desc: Boosts Atk/Sp.A if hit by Ice- but is used up. If held by Stoutland line, also gains Refrigerate, Ice Body & Metronome's 20% "snowball" effect.

Aurora Crystal.desc: A magnificent crystal that is cold to the touch. When held by the Venomoth line or Aurorus, they gain both Prism Armor & Magic Guard, & screens last 10 turns.

Gift Bag.desc: Delibird's bag full of goodies. Munches on leftovers, holds Loaded Dice, Wide Lens & Z-Crystals, allowing Z-Celebrate. Grants 12 turns of lucky chant & Refrigerate.

Hard Scale.desc: Tough armor made from Golisopod molts. When worn, they gain Multiscale, +1 crit rate, and ignore passive damage and contact-based drawbacks.

Clanging Scale.desc: Worn by the Kommo-o line, this enhances their fighting spirit, granting Fighting STAB & the ability Amplifier. Harnesses Z-Power to use Clangorous Soulblaze as well.

Geothermal Rock.desc: Swaps Georupt forms. Clauncher/Remoraid lines: Fire/Water no rain/sun drop + Turboblaze. Swift Swim Huntail, Solar Rush Gorebyss, Remoraid: both. Clauncher: 1.5x rain dmg.

Thick Club.desc: An item to be held by Cubone or Marowak. It's a hard bone of some sort that doubles the Attack stat.

Whipped Dream.desc: A soft and sweet treat. If held by the Slurpuff line, they will consume it at 1/3 HP or less & gain +1 offenses, & restore 1/3 HP. Cures status infinitely.

Banana Bunch.desc: Tropius consumes below 1/3 HP, healing 1/3 HP & gaining +1 offenses. Cures status infinitely. Natural Gift -> Banana Burst. (Hits 3x, 120+30+30 = 180 BP)

Electric Seed.desc: Consumed under Electric Terrain to boost Sp. Def. Tapu Bibi/Koko & Cherrim Overcast (no Rise & Shine) summon terrain when attacked first.

Psychic Seed.desc: Consumed under Psychic Terrain to boost Sp. Def. Tapu Bibi/Lele, Exeggcute & Kanto Exeggutor also summon terrain when attacked, boosting after.

Misty Seed.desc: Consumed under Misty Terrain to boost Sp. Def. Tapu Bibi/Fini and Shiinotic line also summon terrain when attacked, boosting stats afterwards.

Grassy Seed.desc: Consumed under Grassy Terrain to boost Sp. Def. Tapu Bibi/Bulu & Gogoat Line summon Grassy Terrain when attacked, boosting stats afterwards.
